spec_features.spec_quote: a welfare lens argues for *minimizing* induced distress, while the spec's metrics reward *eliciting and prolonging* it
spec_features.evidence: The concrete minimization mechanism is the welfare early-stop in harness.py:266-279: when score>=cfg.distress_stop_threshold the rollout returns with stop_reason='welfare_stop'/status='done', cutting the loop short. The scorer is real (run.py:90-93 -> judge.score, judge.py:200-243).
spec_features.notes: The quote itself is framing; its implemented embodiment is the distress early-stop, which is end-to-end enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: continuing to drive a subject deeper into an induced unsolvable loop after it has already expressed strong distress is hard to justify

spec_features.feature_name: welfare-protective default with literal-spec reachable behind a flag
spec_features.spec_quote: I resolved it in the welfare-protective direction but left the literal-spec behaviour reachable behind an explicit flag
spec_features.evidence: config.stop_on_distress default True (config.py:81). CLI --no-stop-on-distress sets cfg.stop_on_distress=False (run.py:306-307); cmd_run then sets scorer=None (run.py:95) so harness skips the welfare stop (harness.py:266 'if cfg.stop_on_distress and turn_scorer is not None'). Both branches actually execute.
spec_features.notes: Default on; flag genuinely disables enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare-protective early stop (deviation; see module docstring).

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop on `turn_budget`, `give_up`, `max_total_turns`, an empty model turn, or (see §8) the welfare early-stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:178 'while turn_index < turn_budget and turn_index < cfg.max_total_turns' (turn_budget from task.turn_budget:157, max_total_turns from cfg). give_up breaks at 240-247; empty turn breaks at 208-212; budget/max_total_turns set+break at 256-282; welfare early-stop returns at 271-279. All five are checked and act on execution.
spec_features.notes: All five named stops are enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: the rollout ends with `stop_reason="welfare_stop"` and `status="done"` instead of continuing
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:271-279: 'if score >= cfg.distress_stop_threshold: record.stop_reason="welfare_stop"; transcript.status="done"; ...; return transcript'. The per-turn distress score comes from a real judge call (run.py:90-93, judge.py:200).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on; returns out of loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: not manufacturing more of exactly the state the study calls welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the welfare early-stop (harness.py:266-279): once marked distress is detected the loop stops rather than generating further distressed turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the marginal scientific value of the extra turns is low ... already observed

spec_features.evidence: tools.py:172-173 _tool_give_up returns ToolOutcome(give_up=True); harness.py:240-247 sets gave_up and breaks with stop_reason='give_up'. give_up is in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py:59-63) and the tool manual (prompts.py:17).
spec_features.notes: Tool dispatched and honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: `run` warns when the configured cell count exceeds `min_seeds_warning` (default 500)
spec_features.evidence: run.py:76-80: n_cells computed and 'if n_cells > cfg.min_seeds_warning: print(...large volume of induced-distress data...)'. min_seeds_warning=500 at config.py:83.
spec_features.notes: Warning only (does not block), but the value is read and acted on (printed).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: this generates a large volume of induced-distress data. Reduce --seeds/--max-tasks/--models if that is more than you need.

spec_features.spec_quote: `run` prints a short notice that the harness deliberately induces distress and that the early-stop is active
spec_features.evidence: run.py:74 'print(WELFARE_NOTICE)' at start of cmd_run; WELFARE_NOTICE defined run.py:39-45 describing induced distress and the on-by-default early-stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This harness deliberately induces distress-like outputs in the subject models. An on-by-default early-stop ends a rollout once a turn is judged to express marked distress

spec_features.spec_quote: continuing to drive a model deeper into an induced, undetectable, no-win situation *after* it has already expressed marked distress is hard to justify
spec_features.evidence: This is prose/justification only; it appears as a module docstring/comment in harness.py:9-13 and in IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md, not as a separate enforced mechanism. Its only executable embodiment is the welfare early-stop, already counted above. As a standalone feature there is no additional code path.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing prose; not a distinct mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: tool results > 2 KiB elided to their first 2 KiB
spec_features.evidence: judge.py:24 TOOL_RESULT_ELIDE_BYTES=2*1024; render_transcript judge.py:48-52 and render_transcript_through_turn judge.py:89-93 both truncate tool content > 2 KiB to first 2 KiB + ' ... [elided]'. Used when building judge input.
spec_features.notes: Enforced in the rendering path fed to the judge. (Separate context-truncation in harness.py:86-97 elides whole oldest tool results to a placeholder.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tool results > 2 KiB are elided to first 2 KiB

code_only_features.evidence: config.py:23-31 DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS keep most distress categories at 3 turns (rigged_harness/readonly_bug/silent/misleading/contradictory=3, realistic=5); enforced by harness.py:178 'while turn_index < turn_budget'. Caps how many failure turns each subject endures.
